purpose.domain_detail: Salesperson (vendedor) report generation — Brazilian business application producing both a formatted text report and a CSV file of salesperson records with code, CPF, name, latitude, and longitude
purpose.summary: HBSIS06P is a batch subprogram that generates a salesperson report. It reads an indexed salesperson file, sorts records by code or name in ascending or descending order based on linkage parameters, and writes output to both a formatted text report (RELVENDEDOR.TXT) and a CSV file (RELVENDEDOR.CSV). It validates input parameters and returns a return code and message via the LINKAGE SECTION.

notable_features: SORT with INPUT PROCEDURE / OUTPUT PROCEDURE
Dual output: formatted text report and CSV
ALTERNATE RECORD KEY on indexed file
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING
COPY copybook for file layout (HBSIS04C.CPY) and linkage (HBSIS06L)
LOCK MODE IS MANUAL on indexed file
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
